title: Slanted awnings of Sylhet
description: Small slanted awnings that act both as shade and rain protection are typical of the roofs of Sylhet, the major city of the northeast.

title: Maize fields (northwest)
description: Maize in Bangladesh is mainly found in the northwest, but small fields, often next to other crops, also occur in the south near Barishal.

title: Pointed tin roofs (west)
description: House roofs differ between west and east Bangladesh. In the west, roofs are pointed, with the tip of the metal sheet pointing outward. In the east, a distinct triangle protrudes from the gable, reminiscent of Sulawesi roofs.

title: Protruding triangle gable roofs (east)
description: House roofs differ between west and east Bangladesh. In the east, a distinct triangle protrudes from the gable, reminiscent of Sulawesi roofs. In the west, roofs are pointed, with the tip of the metal sheet pointing outward.
